outline_metadata.logline: A perfume bottle emerges from darkness through controlled soft light, revealing glass, amber liquid, and reflection before settling into a quiet hero hold.

scene_and_location_map.lighting_setup: large diffused upper-left key, stable cap highlight, soft glass edge light, seamless gray-to-amber gradient

protagonist_arc.starting_state: mostly contained in darkness with silhouette and partial highlights
protagonist_arc.closing_state: fully legible, materially resolved hero product with coherent reflection

acts.story: The bottle quietly emerges from darkness as the upper-left soft light reveals its silhouette and first glass contours.
acts.transition_in: Begin from the existing dark gradient and centered product composition.
acts.transition_out: The reveal settles into a closer material view without changing the bottle geometry.
acts.image_expansion: slow push and controlled light reveal only

acts.story: The camera gives the black cap, refractive glass edges, and uniform amber liquid a restrained tactile emphasis.
acts.transition_in: Continue the same light direction and centered axis from act_01.
acts.transition_out: Return toward the full product silhouette and reflection.
acts.image_expansion: micro-parallax and subtle push toward material details

acts.story: The complete bottle and its softly fading reflection hold in a composed premium frame, ending with quiet confidence.
acts.transition_in: Ease out from the material detail while preserving highlight continuity.
acts.transition_out: End on a stable hero frame with no structural change.

segment_by_segment_synopsis.story_beat: Dark emergence and first material reveal.
Controlled material study of cap, glass, liquid, and atomizer.
Quiet full-product hero hold with coherent reflection.

audiovisual_directing_guidelines.color_scheme_mapping: Deep black and charcoal frame the warm amber liquid; pale gray upper gradient transitions smoothly toward warm dark lower tones.
audiovisual_directing_guidelines.camera_language: Locked 65mm-like product perspective with a very slow push, restrained micro-parallax, and no handheld movement.
